name: Microbial Biology Graduate Program (PhD)
summary: Microbial Biology doctoral research on microbial life processes, diversity and applications.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall PhD application
publishedDeadlines.note: No year stated on official page.

applicationFee.note: Central scholar/military categories apply; program FreeApp waiver specifically for qualifying underrepresented U.S. citizens. International eligibility for other central categories not explicit; confirm.

english.note: Program accepts DET; central consideration range120–130, confirm precise program threshold. Official testing-agency scores valid within two years of semester start. Entire English-medium degree may qualify for case-by-case waiver with official proof.

documents: Personal statement describing microbiology interest and research experience
Transcripts from all colleges/universities, unofficial for review
Original-language records and official complete English translations if needed
requirements.note: CV requested but optional. Relevant advanced microbiology, biochemistry, genetics coursework and research considered. Three references preferably research advisors/advanced-course professors. Committee meets once mid-January; submit all materials including letters before review. Status/funding notification byFebruary. Full-time, fall-only. Distinct from Microbiology&MolecularGenetics under MBS; select Microbial Biology in application.

funding.note: Competitive first-year fellowships. Later good-standing students receive fellowships, research/teaching assistantships depending on advisor resources. No universal/international support guarantee stated.

detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.
